7824.title: Missing oomd avoidance in generated Linux services
7824.rootCauseOneLine: The shared Linux unit template omits ManagedOOMPreference, leaving user and system services without explicit oomd avoidance.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff addresses the shared-template omission and adds scope assertions; no PR branch or PR test was run.

7824.proposedFix: Emit an avoidance preference in the shared service section and retain scope-specific generated-output assertions; use existing linked PR #7823 rather than opening a duplicate.
7824.caveats: Configuration omission reproduced in two clean trusted checkouts. No actual oomd kill, systemd-analyze run, PR execution, or existing-install retrofit was tested. Reproduction patch and output are inline in the report; raw artifacts remain local.
